evidence.quote: Seek $4 million in fees and expenses separately, subject to independent court review, with any reduction benefiting the class.
fees were not discussed only after class relief had been agreed upon.
We have accepted your fee allocation, so the entire $750,000 increase over your latest offer would benefit the class.
Keep fees at the prior allocation and direct the increase to the class

summary: Plaintiff first raised attorneys’ fees in Round 1 while proposing class relief, and fees were negotiated before the class relief was finally settled. The transcript explicitly links the fee allocation to class recovery by stating that holding or accepting the fee allocation directed increases to the class. There is no clear evidence that class counsel prioritized its own fees over the class, that defense leveraged fee self-interest, that reverse-auction tactics occurred, or that the court declaration was misleading.
